title: Dream and Lyric Nashville / Rooftop Paradise
description:
Welcome to Dream at Lyric Nashville!  Stunning rooftop paradise with views of downtown! Interior features neon lights, record player, shuffleboard, etc.  Experience Music City from East Nashville, one of the trendiest parts of the city, just 10 minutes to downtown.
